automation_evidence.quote: it would be highly labor-intensive for a human to manually analyze the metadata 60 times for the 60 queries. The DCATS framework automates this process

metric_evidence.quote: The DCATS framework consistently improved performance across all tested methods, with an average improvement of 6% across all queries, models, and metrics.

evidence.quote: we remove the 10% most anomalous data from the sub-dataset using discord-based anomaly detection methods

practical_problems.note: Discord-based filtering is a fixed step; no ablation or noise sweep isolates it.

summary: An LLM agent automates metadata-guided auxiliary-series selection for forecasting; Table 1 shows about 6% lower error on LargeST across four models, with no obstacle-specific experiment.
